collections.name: base_report
collections.purpose: Primary employee master data and demographic information
important_rules: Only employees with assignment status = ACTIVE should be considered by default
INACTIVE employees should be included only if explicitly requested
This is the source of truth for employee existence and status
example_queries: List all active employees in Sales
Who is the manager of employee John Doe?
Show new joiners for last month
How many active employees are there in Bangalore region?

collections.name: leave_transaction
collections.purpose: Employee leave usage and leave type tracking
important_rules: Total leaves = Sick Leave + Casual Leave + Paid Leave
If no record exists, the employee has not taken any leaves
example_queries: How many leaves has employee A taken?
Total sick leaves taken by an employee
Employees with highest leave usage

collections.name: offboarding_checklist
collections.purpose: Employee exit and offboarding task tracking
important_rules: All exit formalities are complete when status.all task status = Completed
If status.all task status = Pending, some exit formalities are still incomplete
Pending exit tasks are identified by individual fields marked as Pending
example_queries: Is the offboarding completed for employee X?
Which exit tasks are pending for employee Y?
Employees with incomplete exit formalities

collections.name: performance_goal_report_2025_2026
collections.purpose: Approved performance goals for employees for FY 2025–2026
important_rules: An employee can have multiple goals
Total goal weightage per employee must sum to 100
example_queries: What are the goals assigned to employee X?
Show goal weightage breakup for employee Y
List employees with incomplete goal weightage

collections.name: goal_setting_status
collections.purpose: Tracks the status of performance goal setting and approvals
important_rules: Status reflects the current stage of goal approval workflow
Possible values include APPROVED, DRAFT, Pending with Employee, Pending with Manager, Pending with Reviewer, REJECTED, CANCELLED
example_queries: Which employees have not submitted their goals?
Goals pending with manager approval
List employees whose goals are approved

collections.name: permormance_rating_report_year_2025_2026
collections.purpose: Final performance ratings for employees for FY 2025–2026
important_rules: Final status can be Approved, Completed, In progress, or Submitted
example_queries: What is the rating of employee X?
Employees whose ratings are approved
Performance ratings distribution

collections.name: pip_transaction_report
important_rules: PIP task status can be ASSIGNED, INITIAL, or COMPLETE
example_queries: Which employees are on PIP?
Is employee X PIP completed?
Active PIP cases this year

collections.name: pms_task_status_report_all
important_rules: Final status DOCUMENT APPROVED means the PMS cycle is complete
Pending statuses indicate where the document is stuck
example_queries: Is PMS completed for employee X?
PMS pending with manager
Employees with approved PMS documents

collections.name: performance_360_degree_feedback_participants_status_all
important_rules: Participation status can be Awaiting Reply, Not Started, In progress, or Completed
example_queries: Is 360 feedback completed for employee X?
List pending 360 feedback participants

collections.name: goal_detail_report
collections.purpose: Individual Development Plan (IDP) details for employees
important_rules: Development goal status can be COMPLETED, IN_PROGRESS, NOT_STARTED, or NA
example_queries: What is the development plan status for employee X?
Employees with incomplete development goals
